claims.claim: displaced-work: Hydrator rollback work (T-27327) is explicitly deprioritized to next quarter so the dev pair can fund the progressive sync deletion loop, leaving no automated mechanism to revert manifest changes if progressive sync fails mid-way and creating a state inconsistency exposure that cannot be observed until after deployment.

The roadmap explicitly scopes ordered or automated deletion of ApplicationSet children out of rollout orchestration and mandates manual teardown, but the PRD commits to implementing `deletionOrder` (AllAtOnce/Reverse) in the ApplicationSet CRD, creating a direct scope contradiction that forces a roadmap revision or PRD rollback.

Impersonation rollout is gated behind a per-project flag pending a diff fix, but server-side diff requires unbounded `patch` RBAC grants on cluster-scoped resources to function, meaning the security bet of least-privilege sync is foregone for operational continuity and the call ownership remains unassigned.
